title: Enhanced antibacterial and algae inhibition performance by coral sand-supported nano-Ag composites
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01057D, Paper
Sufeng Wang, Fengjing Lv, Wen Zhang, Jingshan Li, Mingyang Lin, Zhengyi Tao
Coral sand (CS) was utilized as a substrate to immobilize nano silver, resulting in the new composite material CS-Ag. CS-Ag could achieve continuous sterilization and algae inhibition.
